title: Decide Linux task-sync exchange cleanup on /proc mounted hidepid=1: tolerate unreadable foreign pid entries or refuse with a stated reason
outcome: Decide Linux task-sync exchange cleanup on /proc mounted hidepid=1: tolerate unreadable foreign pid entries or refuse with a stated reason
acceptance: On Linux with /proc mounted hidepid=1, a task-sync Git exchange either completes its process-group cleanup (unreadable pid entries of other users are treated as not in Git's group) or refuses with a stated reason naming hidepid, never a generic member_enumeration cleanup failure on every exchange
A test covers a permission-denied /proc/<pid>/stat entry during member enumeration
